raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The line plot illustrates the loss over the number of iterations for different configurations of a machine learning model. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," is also a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different model configuration. The "Vanilla" model is depicted by a purple line, the "StrmLLM (n=64)" by a blue line, the "SepLLM (n=64)" by an orange line, the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" by a green line, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" by a red line, and the "SepLLM (n=128)" by a light blue line. All lines show a general trend of decreasing loss as the number of iterations increases, with the "SepLLM (n=64, H)" and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configurations showing the lowest loss values across the iterations. The plot does not include any section titles or annotations beyond the axis labels and the legend.
